_comment: Ultimate Texas Hold'em locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Never translate the action tokens ('[4x]', '[2x]', '[1x]', '[check]', '[c]', '[fold]', '[f]', '[skip]', '[s]', '[play bet 4x]', ...), the card labels/suits (e.g. 'A♠', 'K♥', '10♦'), the phase labels passed in {phase}, or any numeric chip/bet/payout amounts. The escaped literal '${{...}}' fragments in the rules pay table reproduce a pre-existing display bug verbatim and must be kept exactly (double braces are intentional).

_slots.{hand}: A comma-separated list of card labels, e.g. 'A♠, K♥', or the localized no-cards text
_slots.{phase}: The current phase label token (PRE-ROUND, PRE-FLOP, FLOP, RIVER, SHOWDOWN)
_slots.{actions}: A comma-separated list of bracketed action tokens, e.g. '[play_bet_4x], [check]'
_slots.{available}: A comma-separated list of currently legal bracketed action tokens
_slots.{cards}: A comma-separated list of card labels, e.g. 'Q♣, 7♦, 2♠'
_slots.{name}: A localized poker hand name, inserted verbatim
_slots.{net}: The net chip change for the round (may be negative)

player_prompt.rules:
🎯 ULTIMATE TEXAS HOLD'EM - Omuzannyi omu yekka vs Dealer

📖 GAME OVERVIEW:
• Ouzza na {start_chips} chips
• Decki emu ya kadibo 52 (2♠-A♠, 2♥-A♥, 2♦-A♦, 2♣-A♣)
• Ozannyira ku dealer (house)
• Bulungi bwe bukomezeza mu Mukolo wa Ultimate Texas Hold'em: ousisinkana ANTE na BLIND bets, wasomese kadibo 2 za hole, lyoka okusaba kwenkanya bets za PLAY mu mazingira g'okuzannya, kisha wasomese kadibo za community na kusaba hand y'ow'amaanyi 5-card dhidi ya dealer’s. Ekigendererwa kyo kukuza by'owanga (bwe wina hand y'ow'amaanyi), wakati ky'okukomya by'owanga (bwe wina hand mbi)
• Emizannyo gikoma bwe ozza 0 chips oba wansi mu bulungi bwe (LOSS) oba okomeze 1000 bulungi ne chips (WIN)

💰 BETTING STRUCTURE:
• ANTE: Beti esinga kuzingiza ${ante} bulungi bwe
• BLIND: Beti esinga kuzingiza ${ante} bulungi bwe
• PLAY: Beti esisinkana mu mazingira g'okuzannya. Mu bulungi bwe, ozza okusaba kimu kati ya ifulu: (${ante4} bwe kikolebwa mu PRE-FLOP, ${ante2} bwe kikolebwa mu FLOP, oba ${ante} bwe kikolebwa mu RIVER. Ozza na kufuka mu mazzi, kugwa mu hand, na tekusaba beti.)

🎴 CARD DEALING:
• Wasomese kadibo 2 za hole (kadibo ko)
• Dealer asomese kadibo 2 za kufuna (zifunye)
• Kadibo 5 za community zisomese zifunye mukati
• Kadibo za community zisomese zikomekeza mu mazingira g'okuzannya

🏆 DEALER QUALIFICATION:
• Dealer alina okusaba pair (kadibo 2 za rangi emu) okusasula, kwa kutumia kadibo 2 mu mukono gwe na kadibo 5 za community.
• Okusasula kwa dealer kugendera mu mato g'okuzannya, bwe kiri kuzingiza mu mazingira g'okuzannya.

🎮 GAME PHASES & ACTIONS:
📋 PRE-FLOP:
  • Masulani: [4x] (${ante4}) oba [check]
  • [4x]: Saba ${ante4} PLAY bet, somese kadibo 3 za community za kwanza
  • [check]: Tekusaba beti, somese kadibo 3 za community za kwanza

📋 FLOP:
  • Bwe beti 4x ikolebwa: Kimu [skip] kisobola (kuzingiza kadibo 2 za community za mwisho)
  • Bwe tekusaba beti 4x: [2x] (${ante2}) oba [check]
  • [2x]: Saba ${ante2} PLAY bet, somese kadibo 2 za community za mwisho
  • [check]: Tekusaba beti, somese kadibo 2 za community za mwisho

📋 RIVER:
  • Bwe beti 4x oba 2x ikolebwa: Kimu [skip] kisobola (kuzingiza mu mukolo wa mwisho)
  • Bwe tekusaba beti ya PLAY: [1x] (${ante}) oba [fold]
  • [1x]: Saba ${ante} PLAY bet, kuzingiza mu mukolo wa mwisho
  • [fold]: Fuka mu hand, gwa ANTE na BLIND bets

📋 SHOWDOWN:
  • Kadibo zonna zisomese na zikomekeza
  • Hand y'ow'amaanyi 5-card kubva mu 7 (2 za hole + 5 za community)
  • Bets zikomekeza kwa mujjuzo wa payout

💎 BET PAYOUTS:
📊 ANTE BET:
  • Dealer tekusasula: PUSH (betti ikomerwa)
  • Dealer akusasula & wuna: 1:1 payout (betti + by'owanga)
  • Dealer akusasula & wuna mbi: Beti ilose
  • Tie: PUSH (betti ikomerwa)

📊 BLIND BET:
  • Tekugenderwa na okusasula kwa dealer
  • Wuna: Beti ikomerwa na by'owanga bingi kwa mujjuzo wa hand y'ow'amaanyi
  • Wuna mbi: Beti ilose
  • Tie: PUSH (betti ikomerwa)

📊 BLIND BET PAY TABLE:
  • Royal Flush: 500:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 500}})
  • Straight Flush: 50:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 50}})
  • Four of a Kind: 10:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 10}})
  • Full House: 3:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 3}})
  • Flush: 3:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 3}})
  • Straight: 1:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 1}})
  • Less than Straight: Tekusaba by'owanga bingi

📊 PLAY BET:
  • Tekugenderwa na okusasula kwa dealer
  • Kusaba kwa moja kwa moja: Hand y'ow'amaanyi dhidi ya hand y'ow'amaanyi ya dealer
  • Wuna: 1:1 payout (betti + by'owanga)
  • Wuna mbi: Beti ilose
  • Tie: PUSH (betti ikomerwa)

🎯 POKER HAND RANKINGS (Best to Worst):
  1. Royal Flush: A-K-Q-J-10 za rangi emu
  2. Straight Flush: 5 kadibo zinazofuata za rangi emu
  3. Four of a Kind: 4 kadibo za rangi emu
  4. Full House: 3 za kindi + 2 za kindi
  5. Flush: 5 kadibo za rangi emu
  6. Straight: 5 kadibo zinazofuata
  7. Three of a Kind: 3 kadibo za rangi emu
  8. Two Pair: 2 jozi za rangi tofauti
  9. One Pair: 2 kadibo za rangi emu
  10. High Card: Kadibo kuu ina

⌨️  ACTION COMMANDS:
• [4x] oba [play bet 4x]: Saba ${{self.ante_amount*4}} PLAY bet
• [2x] oba [play bet 2x]: Saba ${{self.ante_amount*2}} PLAY bet
• [1x] oba [play bet 1x]: Saba ${{self.ante_amount*1}} PLAY bet
• [check] oba [c]: Saba (tekusaba beti)
• [fold] oba [f]: Fuka (fuka mu hand)
• [skip] oba [s]: Saba ku bulungi bwe obutono (bwe tekusaba sulani)

💡 STRATEGY TIPS:
• Hand za kwanza za nguvu (jozi, kadibo kuu) zinahitaji 4x bets
• Saba okusasula kwa dealer - hand za duni zinaweza kufunika bwe dealer tekusasula
• BLIND bet inaweza kuwa na by'owanga nyingi na hand za nguvu (Royal Flush = 500:1!)
• Saba chip stack yo! Bwe ikava 0 oba wansi mu bulungi bwe, ozza

⚠️  IMPORTANT NOTES:
• ANTE na BLIND bets zisinkana bulungi bwe
• PLAY bets zisinkana na za kimkakati
• Hakikisha unatuma sulani sahihi, na kimu kati ya ifulu.
